name: SetGraphLimit
comment: Returns two corners of a square axis window. Arguments: arrX, arrY, adjConst. Each limit is the data minimum minus adjConst and the data maximum plus adjConst. The shorter side is expanded equally so the width equals the height. The result is a 2×2 array: the lower corner (x, y), then the upper corner (x, y). Plot both points. Text in adjConst returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
